name: Uranium Royalty Corp.
content: Uranium Royalty Corp. is a pure-play uranium royalty company focused on gaining exposure to uranium prices by making strategic investments in uranium interests, including royalties, streams, debt and equity investments in uranium companies, as well as through the physical purchase of uranium. The company's portfolio includes interests in a diversified group of uranium projects across various stages of development, including production, permitted, and exploration-stage assets in jurisdictions such as the United States, Canada, and Namibia. By leveraging its unique position as the first company of its kind, Uranium Royalty Corp. provides investors with a diversified and scalable vehicle for uranium price participation.

Officers

Scott Melbye(Date: 2019 October)

Chief Executive Officer

Mr. Melbye is a 40-year veteran of the nuclear energy industry having held leadership positions in major uranium mining companies. He is also the Executive Vice President of Uranium Energy Corp. and has served as President of the Uranium Producers of America.

Josephine Man(Date: 2018 August)

Chief Financial Officer

Ms. Man has over 20 years of experience in finance and accounting. She has served as the Chief Financial Officer of several publicly traded companies in the mining and technology sectors.

Directors

Amir Adnani(Date: 2017 August)

Chairman

Mr. Adnani is the founder and Chairman of Uranium Royalty Corp. He is also the President, CEO, and a director of Uranium Energy Corp. and the Chairman of GoldMining Inc.

Scott Melbye(Date: 2019 April)

Director

Mr. Melbye is a 40-year veteran of the nuclear energy industry having held leadership positions in major uranium mining companies. He is also the Executive Vice President of Uranium Energy Corp.

Vina Kim(Date: 2019 October)

Independent Director

Ms. Kim is a lawyer with over 15 years of experience in corporate and securities law. She has served as legal counsel for several mining companies.

Neil Gregson(Date: 2021 October)

Independent Director

Mr. Gregson has over 30 years of experience in the investment management industry, specializing in the mining and energy sectors. He was previously a portfolio manager at J.P. Morgan Asset Management.

John J.S. Knowles(Date: 2023 January)

Independent Director

Mr. Knowles is a Chartered Professional Accountant with over 30 years of experience in senior financial roles in the mining industry. He has served as CFO for several mining companies.
